notes.title: Introducing the Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We hope you’re enjoying the holiday season! This year, to celebrate the Steam Winter Sale, we’ve created the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47776/The_GalGun_Trilogy_Collection/][b]Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection[/b][/url], combining [b]Gal*Gun: Double Peace[/b], [b]Gal*Gun 2[/b], and [b]Gal*Gun Returns[/b] into one irresistible package!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47776/The_GalGun_Trilogy_Collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39260032/b63a37a2f0fbb538ed63912c933b3449501528f9.jpg[/img][/url]

The [b]Gal*Gun Trilogy Collection[/b] includes a [b]15% discount[/b] and is ‘complete the set’ so you can pick up any of the titles you’re missing and still receive the discount. All three titles will also be on sale from now [b]until January 2nd[/b], so it's absolutely the best time to complete your collection or, for newcomers to the series, indulge your curiosity…

It's never too late to jump into the Gal*Gun universe which is expanding into the realms of metroidvania! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081400/Gal_Guardians_Demon_Purge/][b]Gal Guardians: Demon Purge[/b][/url] sees the Kamizono sisters as demon hunters battling through their high school which has been transformed into a demonic castle. We’ve also recently announced a sequel, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253630/Gal_Guardians_Servants_of_the_Dark/][b]Gal Guardians: Servants of the Dark[/b][/url], which features demon sisters Kirika and Masha on a bloody quest to revive their demon lord.

Wishing you all the very best this holiday season and a wonderful new year 💞

PQube and Inti Creates

notes.title: Grim Guardians: Demon Purge is Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Gal*Gunners,

It’s been a while since we were last in touch! Fear not - our friends at Inti Creates have been hard at work in the meantime and are here to announce the release of a brand new adventure set in the Gal*Gun universe. Take control of the Kamizono sisters, Shinobu and Maya, who many of you will remember from Gal*Gun Double Peace and Gal*Gun 2. Their school has been transformed into a demonic castle, and it’s their job as skilled demon hunters to conquer the castle, rescue their schoolmates, and solve the mystery of what happened to it. 

Each sister has unique abilities and attributes, and they will all come handy when it comes to overcoming the game’s many challenging stages. Grim Guardians features 2-player co-op with special actions, extensive difficulty options with the “Style System,” unique changes on repeat plays, and most importantly the quality and challenge players have come to expect from Inti Creates titles, this time with a new gothic horror aesthetic. You will also get to meet multiple characters from across the Gal*Gun series, but not always in the forms you’re used to!

We hope you enjoy Grim Guardians Demon Purge, which is out now on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series S|X.

Keep an eye out for the physical PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch release coming out later this year, in the form of a standard as well as a collector’s edition! Both can be ordered and shipped worldwide from our friends at Funstock at the following [url=https://funstock.co.uk/collections/grim-guardians-demon-purge]link[/url].

As always, thank you for your continued support. 

Inti Creates & PQube

notes.title: Announcing a new Gal*Gun game!
notes.content:
Dear Gal*Gunners,

We have some exciting news for you!

The very first Gal*Gun, the one that never left Japan, is finally coming to the West! As we near the 10-year anniversary for the franchise, what better way to celebrate than with a freshly remade game?

We're delighted to announce our collaboration with Inti Creates once again on Gal*Gun Returns, coming to Steam, Xbox and Switch next year, fully remade and including more content that the original!

Find more information here:[url=https://pqube.co.uk/gal-gun-returns/] https://pqube.co.uk/gal-gun-returns/[/url] ! 

Here is the [url=https://youtu.be/oN6jv6bGcdw]trailer[/url] with some teaser footage of what's to come! 

We'll have more news soon as well as a Steam page for the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26356630/16305b8781c7df135516bb5bee32518d5d395a4c.png[/img]

notes.title: Gal*Gun Double Peace - Ultimate Edition
notes.content:
Hey lewd lovers! Good news! 

Whether you've never dabbled in the Gal*Gun love or you've already got some of it but not everything, we've prepared some tasty bundles on both Gal*Gun 2 and Gal*Gun Double Peace for you! You'll be able to complete your sets and get more than 60% off on the whole bundle of DLC!

Gal*Gun: Double Peace is a rail-shooter like no other, and has become a genre-defining game for an entire generation of players. As a celebration of this glorious game and in order to bring people back into the wonderful world of girls throwing themselves at you, the Ultimate Edition was created for your enjoyment. 
This edition includes all DLC to date, with the exception of Pheromone Z:
-	Two ‘size’ modifiers, so you can customize to your taste: Demon Pork Buns and Angel Cutting Board.
-	21 costume sets to dress up the girls around the school in the outfit of your choice: Ripped Uniform, Cunning Kunoichi, Wedding Dress, Sakurazaki Squad 777, Sexy Ribbons, Festival Time, Bunny Kigurumi, Chinese Dress, Maid Uniform, Courageous Hero, Bewitching Sorceress, Revitalizing Cleric, Captivating Dancer, Queen of Pain, Shrine Maiden, Blast From the Past, You’re a Squid Now, Summer Vacation, Hidden Desire, Prisoner of Love, and Bear Kigurumi.
We hope you enjoy this bouncy bundle and have fun with Gal*Gun: Double Peace!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hi guys!

Just to let you know we've fired out our first patch to obliterate some issues that have been reported on the Gal*Gun discussions page and on social media. We're keeping our sights pin-pointed on all activity so it is greatly appreciated when players report any issues that pop up. Thanks to everyone for your support so far!

[b]Changelog[/b]
- A bug that was causing the physics engine to work improperly in some places has been fixed.
- Various other small bugs have been fixed.
